name: taskmate
description: TaskMate: a full-stack workspace for freelancers to manage tasks, clients and invoices (React, Express, MongoDB).
author: Juan Soria

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
